title.zh: 【谷歌为 Anthropic 的 190 亿美元租约提供支持，违约时或获 TeraWulf 项目子公司股权】
title.en: 【谷歌为 Anthropic 的 190 亿美元租约提供支持，违约时或获 TeraWulf 项目子公司股权】

current_state.zh: Google agreed to support Anthropic's roughly $19 billion, 20-year lease for 401MW at TeraWulf's Kentucky data center project, and could take over the lease or obtain equity in the project subsidiary Raylan Data if Anthropic defaults.
current_state.en: Google agreed to support Anthropic's roughly $19 billion, 20-year lease for 401MW at TeraWulf's Kentucky data center project, and could take over the lease or obtain equity in the project subsidiary Raylan Data if Anthropic defaults.
